run_benchmarks_flux: run benchmarks on the FLUX.1-dev transformer model with bf16 precision and torch compile
create_benchmark_scenario_bf16: create a benchmark scenario for FLUX.1-dev with bfloat16 dtype and full graph compilation
create_benchmark_scenario_bnb_nf4: create a benchmark scenario for FLUX.1-dev with 4-bit NF4 quantization using BitsAndBytesConfig
create_benchmark_scenario_layerwise_upca: create a benchmark scenario for FLUX.1-dev with layerwise upcasting enabled
create_benchmark_scenario_group_offload: create a benchmark scenario for FLUX.1-dev with leaf-level group offloading to CPU
